s: December 29, 2023 - Endometritis is a persistent inflammatory disease with a prevalence of 2.8–56.8% in infertile women and is related to adverse pregnancy outcomes [3, 8]. Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) classifies CE as a dampness and heat syndrome and emphasizes the importance of tonifying Qi and nourishing blood, clearing away heat and detoxification, promoting water, and seeping dampness [9, 10]. Gynecological Tiaoqi Jiedu formula has been used for many years in gynecological clinics to treat endometritis with certain effects in improving menstruation and pregnancy rate.
